LanguageData.ARIO_ArrivalStatus_Rules:
When shopper arrivals are on, a designated market gets one 50% roll at 06:00 local time each day. A successful roll schedules 1–5 trading parties of 2–5 people between 08:00 and 22:00. Parties arrive at least two in-game hours apart and visit for roughly eight hours. Visits can overlap.

Blocked parties retry every 15 in-game minutes, keeping their planned size and the two-hour arrival gap. Parties still unable to arrive expire at midnight. The map's shopper switch and arrival schedules survive saving and loading. Turning shoppers off cancels pending groups but never ejects parties already visiting; turning them back on waits for the next normal 06:00 roll, with no catch-up burst.

A market opened or first updated after 06:00 starts at the next morning's check. Ordinary visitors and player-negotiated trades are unaffected by the shopper-arrival switch. Each scheduled trading party shares 5000–8000 silver for its entire visit; ordinary visitors share 1000–2000 and trader caravans 2000–3000. Rare wealthy patrons can have more. Remaining budgets survive saving and loading. Select a shopping visitor to see the shared balance. Hovering this status shows today's planned local arrival times.

A trading party of {0} people from {1}, representing {2}, has arrived to browse your market.

The party includes: {3}.

They intend to stay for roughly eight hours, buy goods that interest them, and carry their purchases home. Danger or unsafe temperatures may make them leave early.
